s02082.summary: Residents argue in whispers in a zero-gravity laundromat as clothes float in soap.
Lin demands who washed coolant; everyone looks at Oskar, and Doc Fenwick orders them out.
A washer turns red and bursts, engulfing all six in pink foam.

s02275.summary: Six people check sleeper pods in a frozen cryo-vault, counting aloud.
Bright says count again; every pod is open and empty, and Kestrel asks who counted them.

s01011.summary: Strangers do laundry in a motel laundry room, trading banal remarks about stains.
A washer runs pink and Rhonda's baby monitor picks up wet breathing.
The clerk gives his name Dale; the breathing comes from a dryer, and Trudy opens it.

s00063.summary: Thessalonike's skiff crashes into the dock of a floating sky-market.
She assigns errands and they split up to hunt for an unmapped passage.
Cornelius buys saffron, Morwenna awes a weaver, and Thessalonike finds an iron door.
They regroup; the door opens on a stair of falling stars and they enter.

s00441.summary: Honeymoon morning erupts as Harry, Gwendolyn, Mildred and a bellhop pile into the suite.
Bellhop trips with the cart and a parrot lands on him; slapstick chaos ensues.
Pearls found on the breakfast tray; Mildred grimly claims them and exits.

s01994.summary: Four people gather at a table with a briefcase in a ghost subway station.
Arvid refuses to open the briefcase yet, warning it will bind them all.
Arvid probes Lorcan and Irene about the night a man was found dead.
Tamsin reveals the case holds Dominic's record, and Arvid offers three choices.
Tamsin sits Lorcan down; Irene opens the latch and light spills out.

s02414.summary: Veteran night nurse Rosaleen dictates notes and ignores a blinking call light.
She checks bay six, finds a sleeping patient, and straightens his blanket.
Her recorder plays back an unremembered voice saying it's cold in here.
She mutters long night and walks the ward checking each bay.

s00159.summary: Stranded Astrid tries her emergency radio and gets only static.
She plays a recording telling her mother she wasn't scared.
A shape on the ridge turns out to be a caribou, which wanders off.
The radio clicks back three times and Astrid announces she is alive.

s01970.summary: Foreman Ngozi tells her plow crew the county cut the overnight run.
Arlo plans a grievance while rookie Billie and Tomasz absorb the loss.
Ngozi admits she took a deal that cuts Tomasz and Billie.
Tomasz coaxes Billie to say she wants to burn it down; they laugh, then he turns away.
Ngozi signs the grievance first and passes it around to file at nine.

s02494.summary: Five thieves drop through a skylight into a tide mill museum at night.
They take positions and Fenwick cracks the case on the bronze tide-clock.
The drugged guard appears; Delilah steers him back to bed while the crew freezes.
They pack the clock and climb out; Odile blesses the wheel.

s01266.summary: Inspector Quigley-Abara asks housekeeper Prunella about finding the professor's body.
The Inspector finds chalk and sees Prunella hiding a lipstick-marked sherry glass.
She presses Prunella about sherry and the stool; the saw cut shows it wasn't a fall.
Prunella admits sawing the stool because he would sell the telescope.
Prunella sits resigned as the Inspector bags the glass and promises tea.

s01527.summary: Detective Cordelia joins Gus in a funeral parlour viewing room at his request.
Gus pours tea, asks her to sit, and talks of forty years with his wife.
Cordelia raises wrist bruising and the staircase, and Gus offers evasions.
She produces an evidence bag and breaks his lodge alibi with the sign-in book.
Gus drops his mask, says she did not suffer, and offers his wrists.

s00599.summary: Boss Kovacs demands the money from jittery Spuds, who is nineteen thousand short.
Kovacs orders Deacon to open his basket, revealing banded cash.
Deacon says he was keeping the money safe for Spuds' coming baby.

s01712.summary: Joanna hesitates over a phone beside cold noodles, then calls Daniel.
She hears Daniel's voicemail greeting, cannot leave a message, and hangs up.
The phone buzzes with Daniel's name; she lets it ring before answering silently.
Daniel apologizes for not calling sooner; Joanna weeps and smiles.

s00971.summary: Hull pressure drops in the orchard; Tavita tries to keep the crew calm.
With thirty seconds of air, Isaak assigns drones, patch kit and Osei's retreat.

s01682.summary: Gretchen counts plates while a cardigan-wearing man scrubs pans in an empty kitchen.
Walter says he's with the Thursday group but is on no sign-in sheet; the clock is stuck.

s01949.summary: Dr. Mahoe's surgical team works toward closing in ten minutes.
The anaesthetist reports saturation dropping to ninety-one; Mahoe orders ventilation.
Tomasz exhales as the monitor settles.

s00131.summary: Six people squeeze around a wedding cake in a hotel service elevator.
The elevator stalls and the group bickers and panics about heat and the alarm.
The cake sways and everyone lunges in a chain to save it.
The bride announces she is leaving the groom; doors open on two hundred guests.

s01333.summary: Six survivors crowd a lifeboat at dawn with an empty water jug.
A cracking oar sets off bickering; Hess forbids seawater and says they are alive.

s01578.summary: Kagwe challenges Commander Lundqvist's reassuring oxygen figures and accuses him of lying.
A leak appears; they fight over patching it and shove each other.
Alarms chirp; something large and pale slides past the porthole.

s00822.summary: Dr. Voss and her relaxed team finish a flawless surgery in a rooftop greenhouse.
Chief of surgery Anselm enters and summons Voss outside, silencing the room.

s02373.summary: Accountant Dee catches Barnaby's prize-pool math error; the hat cost twenty-eight dollars.
A cosy lull as they praise the year and wonder about the lone finalist Smith.
The stranger reveals his name is Vance, Marcus's estranged father.
Marcus recalls nine years of absence; Vance says he watched through the fence.
Marcus proposes eighteen holes, loser asks a question; they take their putters.

s01582.summary: Stranded siblings blame each other over dry radiator, spent water and the wrong turn.
A dust plume appears on the horizon; Maribel warns him not to hope.
Old Benedicto arrives in a pickup and gives Maribel water, urging her to drink slowly.

s01522.summary: Priya answers email inside a nap pod; VP Wally audits her nap quota.
Chief Wellbeing Officer Sunniva lets slip the layoff announcement coming after her nap.
Priya closes her laptop and fakes snoring while Wally sweats.

s00521.summary: Bart watches Nkem stare at child's pajamas in a 3 a.m. laundromat.
Nkem erupts, hurls the pajamas, then slumps and says her daughter is fine upstairs.
Bart sits on a bucket and tells her to fold the rest.

s02444.summary: Exhausted Dr. Saoirse enters an empty shipboard theatre and plays a surgical recording.
The recording of a patient's death shakes her; she says she did everything right.
She dictates the cause of death, voice breaking, and whispers an apology.
She wraps herself in a blanket and sits alone in the dark.

s01982.summary: Pemberton-Hale berates Gwendolyn over a four percent productivity dip while a gray man watches.
A call reveals the gray man is efficiency reviewer Voss, to Pemberton-Hale's dismay.
Voss shows the department meets target, undercutting the manager's complaint.
Gwendolyn calmly excuses herself to file claims and closes the door.
